_comment: Retired instructions per cryptographic operation. Unlike benchmarks/baseline.json these are a property of the binary and its input rather than of the runner: the same operations measured bit-identical idle and under 150% CPU oversubscription, where the wall-clock lane swung 2.1x on the same binary. Gated by tools/check_instruction_counts.py at 2%, against 45% for wall-clock. Regenerate with benchmarks/measure_instruction_counts.py.

arch=x86-64 sha3=AVX2 kyber=AVX2 dilithi.measured_on: the ubuntu-latest (26.04) toolchain: gcc 15.2.0-16ubuntu1, cmake 4.2.3-2ubuntu2, valgrind 3.26.0, in a resolute chroot; trees without the x86-64 baseline pin built with -march=x86-64-v3 to reproduce the runner's amd64v3 compiler default; Release static library with LTO, driver -O2, AMA_DISPATCH_NO_AUTOTUNE=1, difference method at N=10; x86-64 host with AVX2/BMI2/ADX/VAES/VPCLMULQDQ/SHA-NI/AVX-512, dispatch fingerprint 'arch=x86-64 sha3=AVX2 kyber=AVX2 dilithium=AVX2 sphincs=AVX2 aes_gcm=AVX2 ed25519=Generic C chacha20poly1305=AVX2 argon2=AVX2 x25519=AVX2'. Calibrated before use: 702e253 measured here reproduced the runner's own A/B measurement of 702e253 (run 42244243340) on 17 of 18 operations exactly and ed25519_sign within 4 Ir (0.001%); head ffa5b2ec (this branch, with the x86-64 baseline pin). Supersedes the 2026-09-24 gcc 13.3 profile measured at 5fdd02c. Re-recorded 2026-11-08: aes_256_gcm_encrypt, chacha20poly1305_encrypt, dilithium_keygen/sign/verify, hkdf_derive and kyber_keygen/encapsulate/decapsulate are the runner's own head measurement of fbefa4c (A/B job 128690957185, merge-base c0f2254), the head values benchmarks/instruction-count-acknowledgements.json records; every other row is unchanged. Re-recorded 2026-11-10 for the stack clearing of INVARIANT-6: aes_256_gcm_encrypt, chacha20poly1305_encrypt, dilithium_keygen/sign, hkdf_derive and kyber_keygen/encapsulate/decapsulate were recorded as predictions (the runner's head count for 5536e51, A/B job 128838420676, plus the change measured locally with gcc 14.2.0), because the A/B job was skipped on 6cc2d14. Re-recorded 2026-11-11: every row is the runner's own head measurement of df9974c (A/B job 130227909326, merge-base c0f2254; ubuntu-26.04 image 20261101.186.1, gcc 15.2.0, cmake 4.2.3-2ubuntu2, valgrind 3.26.0-0ubuntu1; all 18 operations reproduced exactly within the run). The eight predicted rows were within 0.09% of it; the ten others had last been recorded before the stack clearing and moved by up to 1.65%.
